
  Clone a git repo and connect to it as a session                                                                       
         
  USAGE  
         
    sesh clone <repo> [-- <extra git flags>] [--flags]  
         
  FLAGS  
         
    -c --cmdDir  The directory to run the git command in
    -C --config  Path to config file
    -d --dir     The name of the directory that git is creating
    -h --help    Help for clone
